text:
elaine: Prospect (FiscalBank) requests a fully air-gapped POC. Needs: sealed delivery, signed provenance, offline activation, upgrade cadence, rollback plan, and pricing for sealed envs. Can we assemble a quick scoping reply?

jonah: SE checklist to hand off: bootstrap image, offline bundle (tar), signed SBOM, verification commands, minimal install runbook, delta patch plan. Confirm KMS ownership (customer vs our appliance).

marco: Packaging: layered artifacts (runtime, model, deltas). Model swaps often need full bundle unless chunked overlay used. Suggested cadence: monthly critical patches, quarterly feature bundles. Weekly pushes possible with expedited fee.

priya: Commercial: sealed deployments usually reserved-node pricing + sealed-support uplift. Need expected GPU count and patch SLA to quote. Include optional managed patching fee and onsite install rate.

marcus-legal: We'll need an On-Prem Addendum, export control check for models, tamper-evidence clause for signing, and license activation method (offline token vs local license server). Also confirm audit log retention requirements.

annah-ops: Runbook/rollback: avoid destructive DB migrations in POC. If migrations required, include backup/snapshot + offline migration steps. Acceptance flow: smoke -> perf (tokens/sec) -> canary restore window 30m. Rollback: redeploy previous bundle, purge KV cache, restart agents; document exact commands.

elaine: Action items: @jonah create POC deliverable checklist & verify commands by EOD Fri; @priya draft 6-month commercial sketch; @marcus-legal outline required clauses; @annah-ops draft rollback runbook. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with customer next Tue.

jonah: I'll include example manifests and cosign verification snippets.

priya: I'll pull numbers for reserved nodes + sealed uplift and include expedited patch pricing.

marcus-legal: I'll start the addendum and run export checks.

annah-ops: I'll draft rollback steps and include snapshot commands.

elaine: Thanks :thumbsup:
